source_documents.title: A novel ratiometric fluorescent probe through aggregation-induced emission and analyte-induced excimer dissociation

reference_evidence_units.quote: almost no photoluminescence signals can be recorded
reference_evidence_units.subject: 9-anthraldehyde
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Good solvents including DMSO; excitation 365 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The parent molecule is nearly nonemissive in molecularly dissolved conditions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The paper attributes this to ICT; low emission alone would not identify a unique quenching pathway.

reference_evidence_units.quote: intramolecular charge transfer occurs from the electron-donating anthracene moiety to the electron-accepting aldehyde group.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 9-anthraldehyde
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of emission in good solvents and reaction-induced changes.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source assigns solution quenching to anthracene-to-aldehyde ICT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A source interpretation supported by chemical perturbation, not an independently time-resolved charge-transfer measurement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a new and strong emission peak emerges at 516 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: 9-anthraldehyde aggregates
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 20 micromolar parent dye in DMSO/water or methanol/water mixtures.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Adding water produces a 516 nm band assigned to excimers; the source reports about 90-fold enhancement at 99% water.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Poor-solvent aggregation is not by itself proof of a specific excimer geometry; the source assignment is preserved with this limit.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the hydrodynamic ones in the solution.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 9-anthraldehyde aggregates
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TEM of dried aggregates and DLS of dispersion, Fig. 3.
reference_evidence_units.statement: TEM sizes are reported as 80-100 nm while DLS gives about 200 nm, attributed to the hydrodynamic measurement.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Dry-state TEM and solution DLS dimensions are different observables; do not present them as contradictory measurements of an identical state.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the aldehyde group turns into the alkyl sulfonate moiety
reference_evidence_units.subject: 9-anthraldehyde and sulfite reaction product
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Parent/product proton NMR comparison in DMSO-d6, Fig. 7.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The aldehyde proton signal near 11.48 ppm is replaced by a product signal near 5.48 ppm, supporting nucleophilic addition.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The product is chemically different from the parent input. This is a covalent response, not reversible noncovalent host-guest binding.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the nanoaggregates display a quantum yield of 14.2%
reference_evidence_units.subject: parent aggregates and sulfite adduct
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Main-text report of Table S1 yields and spectral response.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The reported yield is 14.2% for parent aggregates and 23.5% for the charged product, whose emission moves toward 416 nm as aggregates dissolve.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Product yield and blue emission must not be reported as properties of unchanged 9-anthraldehyde.

reference_evidence_units.quote: react with these biothiols (more than 2 h, Fig. S11)
reference_evidence_units.subject: 9-anthraldehyde responding to biothiols versus sulfite
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Selectivity assays use approximately 2 min incubation; text contrasts kinetics.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Sulfite responds within minutes, whereas thiol reactions require much longer; short-window selectivity is partly kinetic.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No response in the short assay does not establish absolute nonreactivity toward biothiols.

reference_evidence_units.quote: in MeCN:H2O = 1:99 (v/v)) placed on copper grid
reference_evidence_units.subject: 9-anthraldehyde TEM samples
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fig. 6 caption for reaction-dependent TEM; bulk sensing mainly DMSO/water.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The TEM caption specifies MeCN/water although the main sensing protocol uses DMSO/water.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Keep this source-level medium discrepancy visible rather than silently merging all conditions.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source links dark parent emission and its chemical release to ICT involving the aldehyde. Do not relabel this automatically as a separately established PET mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source's central ratiometric explanation is aggregate/excimer formation followed by reaction-induced dissociation.
